subject: Request: pilot extension & credits due to integration lock
messages:
From: Emma Lawson <emma@hightide.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
Cc: Sam Ringer <sam.ringer@hightide.ai>
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot blocked by sync deadlock — asking for extension and sandbox credits

Hi Vivek,

Quick note from our engineering lead — we've hit a sync deadlock between our webhook retry logic and your SDK's session restore. The integration team estimates ~3 weeks to complete a fix and another week for internal QA.

We were hoping Redwood could: 1) extend our pilot window by 30 days and 2) provide an additional 150k sandbox tokens to keep our E2E tests and demo fixtures running while we fix the issue.

I attached the integration-errors.log (excerpt) so you can see the back-and-forth.

We really want to keep momentum on the proof-of-concept (our execs are asking for the demo on Oct 18) — an extension would make a big difference. Happy to jump on a quick call.

Thanks,
Emma Lawson
Head of Product, Hightide AI
emma@hightide.ai

Attachment: integration-errors.log (text, 42KB)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot blocked by sync deadlock — asking for extension and sandbox credits

Ben / Kimberly — forwarding a pilot extension ask from Hightide. Key asks: 30-day pilot extension + 150k sandbox tokens. They attached a log file.

Questions for ops/legal: do we have flexibility to approve that token amount under the current free-trial policy? If we can't do full 150k, what's an acceptable bridge?

Steph — can you confirm whether any billing/entitlement gating will kick in if we extend the pilot on our side? I want to avoid an auto-transition to paid before their demo window.

Proposed reply: offer 30 days conditional on delivery of the attached mutual-action-plan (MAP) and an engineering milestone (webhook test passing). If Ben approves, I'll send a customer-facing note.

—Vivek
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 19 Sep 2028 18:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot blocked by sync deadlock — asking for extension and sandbox credits

Vivek —

I can authorize an exception here but want to limit operational exposure. Approve a 30-day extension but provide a credit of 75k sandbox tokens (not 150k) up front. If Hightide hits the engineering milestone (webhook test passing and MAP signed) within that 30 days, provide the remaining 75k credit.

Please include the following in the reply so we have an audit trail:
- Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with target dates and a single engineering smoke test (webhook retry passes for 10k messages).
- Hightide agrees to a follow-up readiness call with our Solutions Engineer within two weeks.

Kimberly — will this need any billing-side overrides? Steph, can you draft the entitlement change to avoid autopromotion to paid during the extension?

I attached a quick note to include in the customer reply.

—Ben

Attachment: internal-approval-note.txt (short)
From: Emma Lawson <emma@hightide.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Cc: Sam Ringer <sam.ringer@hightide.ai>, Procurement <procure@hightide.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Sep 2028 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot blocked by sync deadlock — asking for extension and sandbox credits

Thanks Vivek and Ben — really appreciate the quick response. We can accept the staged credit approach.

I've attached our updated mutual-action-plan (mutual-action-plan-v2.pdf) with dates for the fix and the QA window. We are committing to:
- Code fix deployed to staging by 2028-10-03
- Webhook smoke test (10k messages) completed by 2028-10-07
- Readiness call with Redwood SE: week of 2028-10-09

Procurement — please confirm you are ok with the extension so we can keep the contract window aligned with the demo.

Emma / Sam / Procurement —

Thanks for the MAP and the clear dates. Approved per internal exception:
- 30-day pilot extension (new end date: 2028-10-19)
- 75k sandbox token credit issued now
- Remaining 75k sandbox token credit to be issued upon verification of the webhook smoke test and signed MAP

Action items:
- Hightide to upload proof of smoke-test results to the shared GDrive folder and mark the MAP signed by procurement
- Redwood Solutions Engineering (Kimberly & Steph) to schedule the readiness call week of 2028-10-09 — Kimberly, please own scheduling; Stephanie, please create the temporary entitlement to prevent auto-promotion to paid.
